item.text: The core flow shows three likely gaps: the hook can dispatch a list load without checking ongoing backend work, the query helper drops the API’s freshness flag, and the load thunk treats every resolved response as usable. I’m checking the retry and backend action call sites next to pin down the affected behavior.

item.text: The retry failure path is especially concrete: the thunk dispatches `retry` after two seconds, but the slice has no reducer case for it. A rejected load also has no reducer case, so `pendingRequest` stays true. I’m recording these findings and the remaining integration uncertainty now.

# Fault localization progress

Inspected the mailbox hook, elements state/actions/reducers/selectors/query helper, existing mailbox element tests, and representative item mutation hooks. No project source or tests modified.

Findings:
- "'`useElements.ts` calls `loadingSelector(state)` without `{ page, params }` (line 99). Its main effect (116-129) has no pending backend operation count or guard, so reset/load/page updates can run while item mutations remain active.
- `elementsActions.ts` load thunk (23-43) directly returns `queryElements`; there is no stale response check. Its error timer dispatches `retry` at 2 seconds, but `elementsSlice.ts` does not register `retry`, and no rejected-load reducer clears `pendingRequest`. This can strand loading after a failure.
- `elementQuery.ts` (41-47) discards API `Stale`; `QueryResults` in `elementsTypes.ts` (86-90) has no `Stale` field. A stale response therefore reaches `loadFulfilled` (51-68) and commits total, pages, and elements.
- `ElementsState` and `newState` have no `pendingActions`; selectors have no accessor. The `loading` selector (184-187) omits `shouldSendRequest`, so it misses requests implied by current page/params.
- No `backendActionStarted`/`backendActionFinished` dispatches appear under `applications/mail/src/app`. Representative label/move/mark/delete hooks do run async API work; wiring action lifecycle dispatches to these or a shared wrapper appears necessary for the counter to reflect real work. Exact integration scope remains uncertain.
- Existing `Mailbox.elements.test.tsx` covers pagination/placeholders but does not cover stale results or fetch failure retry.

Behavior to cover: defer list reload until all overlapping backend item operations finish; clear pending request and retry failures after 2s with bounded count; reject `Stale === 1` without committing it and retry after 1s; maintain loading for current page/params until valid data arrives. Avoid letting a stale-response throw also schedule the generic error retry.
EOF'

item.text:
I traced the issue and recorded the diagnosis in [checkpoint.md](/app/.codex-role-output/checkpoint.md). I did not edit project source or tests because this pass was limited to fault localization.

- [useElements.ts](/app/applications/mail/src/app/hooks/mailbox/useElements.ts:99) calls the loading selector without the current page and params. Its load effect also has no guard for backend operations still in progress.
- [elementsActions.ts](/app/applications/mail/src/app/logic/elements/elementsActions.ts:23) accepts every resolved query result. On failure it dispatches `retry` after two seconds, but [elementsSlice.ts](/app/applications/mail/src/app/logic/elements/elementsSlice.ts:72) has no retry case; a rejected load can leave `pendingRequest` true.
- [elementQuery.ts](/app/applications/mail/src/app/logic/elements/helpers/elementQuery.ts:41) drops the API’s `Stale` flag, so [loadFulfilled](/app/applications/mail/src/app/logic/elements/elementsReducers.ts:51) can commit stale elements and totals.

The fix needs to track overlapping backend operations, defer reloads until the count reaches zero, retry failures after two seconds, and retry `Stale === 1` responses after one second without committing them. I found no existing lifecycle dispatches for backend item operations; their integration points remain the main uncertainty.
